# SimpleSign — implementation reference

SimpleSign is a multi-targeted (`net8.0`, `net10.0`) .NET library for PAdES, CAdES and
XAdES signing and validation. It uses only platform cryptography and must remain safe for
Native AOT where the platform XMLDSig implementation permits it.

## Signing contract

`AdesBaselineProfile` is the sole level configuration for PAdES, CAdES and XAdES:

```csharp
var profile = AdesBaselineProfile.Archive(
    new TimestampOptions(new Uri("https://tsa.example")),
    new LongTermValidationOptions(),
    new ArchiveTimestampOptions(new Uri("https://archive-tsa.example")));

var signed = await CadesSigner.Document(content)
    .WithCertificate(certificate, chain)
    .WithLevel(profile)
    .SignAsync();
```

Use `PadesSigner.Document`, `CadesSigner.Document` and `XadesSigner.Document`; logging is
always configured through `WithLogger`. All fluent builders are immutable. Credentials are
mutually exclusive: `WithCertificate` and `WithExternalSigner` replace one another.

`SignWithDetailsAsync` returns an `ISigningResult` with requested and achieved levels,
artifact-derived timestamp/LTV/archive flags and structured warnings. Strict `SignAsync`
rejects profiles configured for best-effort downgrade.

## External signatures

Implement `IExternalSigner`. Its request contains the payload, resolved digest, signature
OID, payload kind, operation ID and PSS parameters. RSA and ECDSA results are verified against
the certificate before CMS/XML packaging. EdDSA signing is intentionally rejected while net8.0
cannot perform equivalent raw-output verification.

## PAdES-specific configuration

`PadesSignerBuilder.WithFieldOptions(SignatureFieldOptions)` atomically replaces field and
appearance configuration and is the explicit way to clear nullable field values. Batch and
deferred PAdES workflows use the same profile/provider/algorithm vocabulary as direct signing.

## Security rules

- RFC 3161 responses must bind to request OID, imprint and nonce.
- TLS/TSA and revocation clients are supplied through `IHttpClientProvider`; callers retain
  ownership of their clients.
- CAdES/XAdES archive claims must be validated from final artifact structure and standards-defined
  preimages. Unsupported XMLDSig transforms or resources fail closed.
- Do not add cryptographic third-party packages, reflection-based serialization, dynamic code or
  unsafe code.

## Verification

Run `dotnet build SimpleSign.sln`, focused project suites beneath `tests/unit/`, CLI tests,
interop tests and the AOT smoke target before release. Cryptographic changes require positive
and negative artifact tests plus independent external vectors where available.
